title: ShaRE your Data! Characterizing Datasets for LLM-based Requirements Engineering

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic mapping study that extracts and analyzes the language metadata of 62 publicly available datasets used in LLM-based Requirements Engineering, revealing a heavy dominance of English and scarcity of multilingual resources.

Categorizing the application and organizational domains of 62 datasets to identify representation gaps, highlighting a concentration in software-centric, mobility, and healthcare contexts while other socio-technical domains remain underexplored.
